data.one_liner: A Flutter layout widget that wraps elements and extends their width to fill each row.
data.what_it_does: FlexList places as many provided elements as possible into a single row like a Wrap widget, but also extends their width using the remaining space so that each row is fully filled. It also supports customizable horizontal and vertical spacing.
use_when: You need a wrap-like layout where items expand to fill the available width of each row.
You want automatic row-filling behavior for flexible list items.
avoid_when: You need standard non-expanding Wrap behavior.
You require complex staggered grid configurations.
strengths: Fills rows to the maximum width automatically.
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond the single layout behavior.
Not documented with extensive configuration options beyond spacing.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need advanced staggered or grid-based layouts instead of a simple flexible row-filling wrap.

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: Not documented as a layout widget alternative.
